metadata.title: Clarity, with character.
metadata.subtitle: An editorial direction for the work we put our name on.

intent.readerAction: Review typography, brand presence and document composition
intent.designRationale: A one-page brand specimen: original Paper logo, expressive variable serif display, deliberate amber, pure-white reading surface and useful typographic contrast. Not a company performance report.

blocks.text: Beautiful documents begin with a clear purpose. The identity should make that purpose easier to see.
The original Rōvn mark anchors the page. Crimson Pro brings character to the headline; Inter keeps the details precise. Amber carries emphasis. Space gives the work room to breathe.

items.title: Compare

blocks.title: The brand belongs in the details.
blocks.text: The mark. The typography. An amber numeral. A deliberate change of scale. A document should feel like Rōvn before the reader reaches the footer.
